content: The training set consists of questions and answers in Swiss Standard German and Swiss French (74.1% de-CH; 25.9% fr-CH). The test sets also contain questions and answers in Swiss Italian (67.1% de-CH; 24.7% fr-CH; 8.2% it-CH). The questions have also been translated into English.
